title: THE DAYS THAT REMAIN
subtitle: 留下来的日子
description: A calendar of recorded days from Zhu Runcang's diary, 1937–1945.
calendar_note: Dates in the diary follow the lunar calendar. Gregorian years are shown only as year-level orientation.

records.title: The first entry
records.summary_zh: 作者将日记的开端放在日军进犯、炮声传来的时刻。地方组织成立抗敌后援会，日常生活开始被战争消息打断。
records.summary_en: The diary begins with the invasion and the sound of artillery. A local anti-enemy support organization is formed; ordinary life is interrupted by news of war.
records.context: The source dates this entry by the lunar calendar. The year 1937 is identified in the text as the twenty-sixth year of the Republic.
records.source: 《近代史资料》第54号，朱润苍《贞丰八年血泪录》，第235–236页。

records.title: Aircraft over the town
records.summary_zh: 日记记载敌机飞临镇上并投弹、扫射，过境运输船遭到攻击，船上人员伤亡。
records.summary_en: The diary records aircraft over the town, bombs and machine-gun fire, and an attack on passing transport vessels that caused casualties.
records.context: This is a dated entry in the first year covered by the diary. The brief description here is a paraphrase, not a complete transcription.
records.source: 《近代史资料》第54号，朱润苍《贞丰八年血泪录》，第236页。

records.title: Rumours and retreat
records.summary_zh: 作者记录战事失利的消息传来，溃军过境，居民开始私下商议迁避。
records.summary_en: After news of a military setback arrives, retreating troops pass through. Residents begin discussing whether and how to leave.
records.context: The entry shows how distant military developments entered local life through radio reports, troop movements, and uncertainty.
records.source: 《近代史资料》第54号，朱润苍《贞丰八年血泪录》，第236–237页。

records.title: A house is hit
records.summary_zh: 日记记载敌机投弹，其中一枚击中杨家潭徐宅，房屋被毁，并有一名妇人死亡。
records.summary_en: The diary records an air raid in which one bomb struck a residence at Yangjiatan, destroying rooms and killing a woman.
records.context: The source gives a specific location and loss. This exhibit does not add details beyond what the entry records.
records.source: 《近代史资料》第54号，朱润苍《贞丰八年血泪录》，第238–239页。

records.title: Fighting nearby
records.summary_zh: 陈部与敌伪军在莘塔附近相遇并发生交火，日记记录枪炮声持续约一小时。
records.summary_en: Forces identified in the diary as Chen's unit and enemy puppet troops encounter one another near Xinta. Gunfire is heard for about an hour.
records.context: The entry is one of many that describe local experience through sounds, movement, and reports rather than a broad military overview.
records.source: 《近代史资料》第54号，朱润苍《贞丰八年血泪录》，第245–246页。

records.title: A brief arrival
records.summary_zh: 日记记载敌军乘船到镇，停留不久后离开。相邻条目继续记录当地武装活动与居民处境。
records.summary_en: The diary notes that troops arrived by boat and left after a short stay. Nearby entries continue to describe armed activity and local conditions.
records.excerpt_zh: 敌军三十余名乘轮二艘到镇
records.context: The record is concise. Its brevity is preserved here rather than expanded into an imagined scene.
records.source: 《近代史资料》第54号，朱润苍《贞丰八年血泪录》，第247页。

records.title: Repeated disruption
records.summary_zh: 日记记载敌伪军到镇勒款、骚扰，商店和居民住处遭到劫掠，翌晨离去。
records.summary_en: The diary records troops demanding money and causing disruption; shops and homes were looted before they departed the following morning.
records.context: This is a summary of the source's account, not an independent verification of every allegation in it.
records.source: 《近代史资料》第54号，朱润苍《贞丰八年血泪录》，第250页。

records.title: A town under pressure
records.summary_zh: 日记记载敌军到镇，封锁交通线并在多处驻扎；地方人士组织临时招待所，应对物资与经济事务。
records.summary_en: The diary describes troops entering the town, restricting transport routes, and occupying several sites. Local representatives organize a temporary reception office to manage supplies and related matters.
records.context: The account moves between military presence, local administration, and the burdens placed on residents.
records.source: 《近代史资料》第54号，朱润苍《贞丰八年血泪录》，第251–252页。

records.title: Another change of command
records.summary_zh: 日记记载驻镇敌队长调动，并继续描述伪机关以经费不足为由，向乡镇摊派柴米。
records.summary_en: The diary notes a change in the local enemy command and describes local offices imposing firewood and rice levies, citing insufficient funds.
records.context: The diary's entries often register changes in local power through seemingly administrative details such as levies and appointments.
records.source: 《近代史资料》第54号，朱润苍《贞丰八年血泪录》，第255页。

records.title: A new appointment
records.summary_zh: 日记记录伪区长调任、继任者到任，以及随后又被撤职的情况。
records.summary_en: The diary records the removal and replacement of a local district head, followed by another change in the position.
records.excerpt_zh: 伪区长刘华云调往湘域
records.context: This entry is presented as a record of administrative change; the exhibit does not infer motives not stated in the source.
records.source: 《近代史资料》第54号，朱润苍《贞丰八年血泪录》，第256–257页。

records.title: An encounter at Nanding
records.summary_zh: 日记记载驻芦墟敌军与“忠救军”在南汀村发生交火，持续约两小时，并记有人员伤亡。
records.summary_en: The diary records an encounter between troops based at Luxu and the Zhongjiu Army at Nanding village, lasting about two hours, with a reported death.
records.excerpt_zh: 枪声激烈，约二小时始止
records.context: The description follows the source's own terminology. The historical labels are retained rather than silently modernized.
records.source: 《近代史资料》第54号，朱润苍《贞丰八年血泪录》，第259–260页。

records.title: A changing situation
records.summary_zh: 日记记载一支自称“特别警卫队”的队伍来到镇上，并描述其驻扎、活动及对地方居民造成的不安。
records.summary_en: The diary describes a unit calling itself the “Special Guard” arriving in town, its presence and activities, and the unease it caused among residents.
records.excerpt_zh: “有识之人，默察其情，咸多忧虑。”
records.context: The exhibit keeps the source's label in quotation marks to distinguish the diary's wording from the curator's voice.
records.source: 《近代史资料》第54号，朱润苍《贞丰八年血泪录》，第262页。

records.title: The final entry
records.summary_zh: 作者记载受降消息传来，随后“黑衣队”撤离，镇上开始公开庆祝，并以“八年血泪至此了结”收束记述。
records.summary_en: The author records news of surrender, the subsequent withdrawal of the “Black-clothed unit,” and public celebration in town. The account closes by saying that the eight years of blood and tears had come to an end.
records.context: The diary's closing passage is the endpoint of this exhibit. It is not presented as the end of all historical suffering or as a complete account of the postwar period.
records.source: 《近代史资料》第54号，朱润苍《贞丰八年血泪录》，第263页。

years.note: Entries continue through the second year.
The surviving account closes in the summer.
